title: Hoodit v1 read-tool contracts
description: Amended 2026-10-01 contract for eight read-only Hoodit tools covering paginated market screening, launchpad lifecycle, token security and ownership, pool comparison, public trades with their senders, and exact-size exit quotes.

x-tools.name: hoodit_search_tokens
x-tools.description: Find Robinhood-chain token candidates by name, symbol, or exact address; never resolves an ambiguous symbol into a trading instruction.

x-tools.name: hoodit_discover_pools
x-tools.description: Browse GeckoTerminal-indexed trending, new, high-volume, or active Robinhood pools. New pools do not necessarily mean newly launched tokens.

x-tools.name: hoodit_get_token
x-tools.description: Inspect an exact Robinhood ERC-20: launchpad lifecycle (curve progress or graduation, defaulting to the destination pool), token mark, capitalization, volume, selected-pool liquidity/activity, and optional metadata. Not an executable quote.

x-tools.name: hoodit_get_token_pools
x-tools.description: Compare indexed pools containing one exact Robinhood Chain token with canonical DEX filtering and scoped local ordering.

x-tools.name: hoodit_get_market_options
x-tools.description: List canonical DEX IDs and the filters, sorts, windows, and free-versus-paid discovery capabilities currently available.

x-tools.name: hoodit_get_candles
x-tools.description: Get single-pool USD OHLCV for an exact token with explicit interval and historical cutoff. Returns source pool and coverage; not wallet performance.

x-tools.name: hoodit_get_trades
x-tools.description: Inspect recent public pool trades, oriented to the requested token. Free-provider window: at most the latest 300 trades in 24 hours; not personal trade history. Each trade keeps its sending wallet; the summary ranks the largest senders in the sample.

x-tools.name: hoodit_check_exit
x-tools.description: Read-only LI.FI exit check: a sell quote for an exact token amount or basis-point fraction, or a buy-then-sell round trip for an ETH amount, with route, expected and minimum output, USD values, loss, gas, and fees. Never prepares, signs, or broadcasts.

Address.description: EVM input address. Output addresses are normalized to lowercase.

TokenId.description: The literal native, or an ERC-20 contract. Never a symbol or a pool ID.

PoolId.description: Opaque GeckoTerminal pool identifier; may be a 32-byte v4 ID, not necessarily a contract address. URL-encode as one path segment.

Decimal.description: Non-negative decimal string, no exponent. Units are specified by the field.

SignedDecimal.description: Signed decimal string. Percentage fields use percentage points: 12.5 means +12.5%, not 0.125.

Atomic.description: Unsigned integer token base units; additionally enforce <= uint256 max.

sender.description: Transaction from-address; may be a router or executor rather than the trader.

Lifecycle.description: Launchpad lifecycle as GeckoTerminal reports it. not_reported means no launchpad record (an instant-pool launch, a non-launchpad token, or not indexed) and is never 0% bonded.
